description: About Eloelo Group Eloelo Group is one of India’s fastest-growing consumer technology companies, building category-defining products at the intersection of content, technology, and culture. The Group’s flagship products, Story TV in micro-drama and Master in micro-learning, have together placed two Eloelo apps in India’s Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short-form vertical content every day. Story TV is India’s leading micro-drama platform, with 10M+ users and 500+ original titles produced in partnership with studios like Balaji Telefilms and Applause Entertainment. Master is India’s #1 micro-learning app, scaling to 5M+ users in 50 days with 1,000+ bite-sized courses across AI, finance, English, and life skills. Role: Product Analyst We are looking for a curious, data-driven Product Analyst to join our analytics team. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and marketing teams to track product performance, understand user behaviour, and turn data into insights that shape how millions of Indians watch and learn on our apps. Key Responsibilities: Write SQL queries to analyse user data on content consumption, feature usage, and engagement. Track and report key product metrics such as DAU, MAU, retention, churn, watch time, and conversion. Build and maintain dashboards and reports in BI tools to give teams clear visibility into performance. Support A/B tests by setting up tracking, monitoring results, and sharing findings, working with senior analysts. Run deep dives into metric changes and funnel drop-offs to find root causes. Validate event tracking and data quality for new feature launches, working with engineering. Turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business teams. Support competitor analysis and track trends in short-form content and app usage. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field. 1–3 years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Analyst, or Business Analyst, preferably at a consumer tech company. Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, and window functions. Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, and basic Python or R. Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase, or similar. Basic understanding of statistics and A/B testing. Clear communication, with the ability to explain data simply to non-technical teams. Interest in entertainment, media, or digital content apps. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with consumer apps such as streaming, gaming, social, or edtech. Familiarity with product analytics tools like Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or Google Analytics. Exposure to agile teams and tools like JIRA and Confluence.

As part of our team, you’ll be contributing to cutting-edge projects that are shaping the future of our company and the industry. At simplesurance, we don’t just embrace change – we drive it. description: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today! Job Details World Courier moves time-critical, life-saving pharma shipments across the globe, and our monitoring services give customers confidence that their product is safe on every leg. You will own the digital product capabilities behind our temperature and location monitoring services: the Temperature Monitor Selection capability, the RTTM/RTLM digital monitoring services (Argos), and the integration and automation roadmap that connects them. This is a high-visibility role that turns monitoring service needs into clear business requirements across TMS, X-Act, Customer Portal, Digital Control Tower and related systems. Why this role matters We are moving from standalone monitoring devices to integrated monitoring solutions, with automated shipment creation, real-time visibility, automated reporting, alerting and less manual handling. You will make that shift real. Your success will be measured by adoption of real-time monitoring, the reliability of our integrations and the reduction in manual effort for Operations and Customer Service. What You’ll Own Roadmap and backlog: You will own and prioritise the roadmap and backlog for the monitoring digital products: the Temperature Monitor Selection capability, the RTTM/RTLM services, and the monitoring integration and automation backlog. Temperature Monitor Selection capability: You will own the capability that guides device selection by packaging type, temperature range and customer requirements, including selection logic, user workflow, data-source alignment and product direction. You will support standardised monitor selection across the network. RTTM/RTLM digital services (Argos): You will own the improvement backlog for the real-time temperature and location monitoring services: adoption, service performance, report generation time and success rate, customer visibility and integration reliability. Integration reliability: You will prioritise fixes for missing RTTM/RTLM URLs and other integration failures, caused by ghost ship units, previous device assignments, incomplete shipment closure, improper shipment creation and monitor-status issues. Business requirements: You will define business requirements and acceptance criteria for monitoring-related changes across TMS, X-Act, Customer Portal, Digital Control Tower, eMDM and downstream systems. IT coordination: You will work with IT development teams on integrations and updates to TMS, X-Act, DCT and Customer Portal, and make sure delivery stays aligned with priorities. Ship unit digital enablement: You will support the digital enablement of monitor ship units, which define monitor type, temperature range, pricing, RTTM/RTLM functionality, reporting and Customer Portal visibility. Automation and automated reporting: You will advance automated shipment creation, report generation and delivery, alerting and customer communications, in order to reduce manual handling. Operations and Customer Service: You will work with Operations and Customer Service to validate monitoring workflows, gather feedback and improve usability. Cross-functional partners: You will work with QA, Cold Chain Packaging, Procurement, Packaging Fleet Management and vendors when enablement depends on qualification, documentation, pricing, ship units, device onboarding or system readiness. You will also partner with the Product Owners for Digital Control Tower and Cold Chain Intelligence, on proactive shipment management and on dashboard strategy respectively. What Success Looks Like Higher RTTM adoption across the network and more confidence in the solution and its value. Lower missing RTTM/RTLM URL rates and more reliable integrations. Faster, more successful report generation, with visible service performance. More automated shipment creation, reporting and alerting, and less manual effort. A confirmed roadmap and ownership model for the Temperature Monitor Selection capability, and consistent monitor selection across packaging types and temperature ranges. Clear, prioritised backlogs and strong stakeholder alignment. What You Bring 5+ years in product ownership or product management, with a strong track record in agile environments. Experience owning a roadmap and prioritising a backlog for digital products or services, and writing business requirements and acceptance criteria. Experience working with IT development teams on system integrations across several platforms. Strong stakeholder management and influence without formal authority in a global, matrixed organisation. Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and KPIs to prioritise and measure outcomes. Comfort working across cultures and time zones. Knowledge of logistics systems (TMS or similar), customer portals, or IoT and real-time tracking solutions is highly desirable. Experience in regulated industries such as pharma, healthcare or logistics is highly desirable. Agile or product certifications (CSPO, SAFe PO or similar) are a plus. English proficiency at C1 level or higher (written and spoken). Additional languages are a plus. Why join us Own a high-visibility digital capability that is critical to World Courier’s value proposition, with real decision-making authority. Shape the next generation of shipment monitoring and visibility. Work internationally with global teams and exposure to senior leadership. Join a re-imagined, product-led IT function driving digital transformation. Hybrid working is based in Madrid or London. Competitive compensation. Contribute to a purpose-driven business delivering essential pharma logistics. What Cencora offers Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements. description: About Mesa Mesa School of Business is India's first VC-backed business school focused on 0-to-1 venture building. It was founded by Harvard, IIT and Kellogg alumni and recently closed a ₹110 Cr Series A. The undergraduate program trains students to build real companies, not just study them. Each cohort is small, selective and outcome-driven. The role in brief This role owns the UG admissions engine end to end. It runs from the first ad impression to the final interview, and it builds the systems that let a cohort of 200–400 students scale without breaking. It sits where sales, marketing, growth and people meet. Half the job is running the funnel. The other half is redesigning it while it runs: new SOPs, new automation, a rebuilt interview process and a growing team. Think of it as building Mesa's go-to-market function for admissions, not just executing a cycle. What you'll own Funnel strategy and growth analytics The goal is not more students. It is better ones: high-quality, high-intent students who are a real fit for Mesa. Every number you track should serve that. Own the full admissions funnel, top to mid: lead → Info Session → MSAT → application → interview → offer. Run a daily lead-quality review across region, campaign and creative. Flag what drives intent, not just volume. Build and track unit economics: CPL, CSQL, CAC, LTV:CAC and ARPU for the cycle. Analyse past cohorts to find real conversion drivers, such as parent alignment and session attendance, and feed them back into targeting. What you'll bring 3–5 years in fast-moving startups, across growth, brand, marketing or community-led businesses. A track record of walking into ambiguity and leaving behind systems others can run. Comfort with numbers: funnel math, unit economics, and spreadsheets you build yourself. Sharp, plain writing for students, parents, investors and internal teams. Experience leading and hiring small, cross-functional teams. Ease switching between strategy, analysis, copy and on-ground execution in the same week. Bonus: event production, cold outreach and partnerships, or EdTech experience.

description: Who you are Are you passionate about Total Rewards and how it creates a comprehensive offer for co-workers? Do you enjoy understanding how systems, processes, and workflows connect end-to-end? Are you someone with a genuine interest in how to improve through a smart combination of technology and processes? If yes — keep reading, this might be your next role! We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Total Rewards team. You will play a key role in shaping and maintaining our Total Rewards area. We believe you bring: Strong knowledge of HR domain and HR processes and systems – SAP SuccessFactors, ADP Global View, Benefits, Variable Pay Experience in data standardization — data models, consistency, and quality Experience owning and communicating a product roadmap, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines The ability to identify gaps in data pipelines and translate them into clear use cases for engineering teams Strong stakeholder management and communication skills — you can bridge business, data, and technology 5–6 years of experience in a similar role within HR Tech and product-oriented environments Proven experience in collaboration driven outcome Strong communication and visualization skills A day in your life with us As a Product Owner in the Total Rewards team, you will play a key role in ensuring that our products across the Total Rewards landscape (Success Factor, Global View, Benefit, as well as in-house built systems) delivers value to the business and supports efficient, data-driven decision-making. You will take ownership of the area, continuously improving it by aligning capabilities with business needs. You will work hands-on with roadmap tools and jira, ensuring solutions support how we actually operate. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the bigger platform area, ensuring alignment and driving adoption. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, where your work directly impacts our many co-workers. This means that you will: Own the overall Total Rewards area end-to-end in a product perspective Translate business needs into solutions, workflows, and improvements Identify gaps between capabilities and business needs, and define solutions Work with various needs, requests and non-functional requirements and consolidate into a product backlog Collaborate with our global business organization, center of excellence as well as our config- and engineering teams Support planning, prioritization, and backlog work Ensure structured and reliable data/process flows Drive adoption by ensuring solutions are practical and user-friendly Manage stakeholders proactively and ensure alignment Continuously improve processes, usage, and quality Together as a Team You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organization. You will be part of a team that is leading the Total Rewards digital solutions — with a clear vision: to bring our Total Rewards solutions to our many co-workers. We are a team that believes in: Being data driven in our approach and decisions Collaborate between people and teams in a pragmatic and open way Continuously learn and improve – the landscape is evolving and so are we Transparency - we communicate our roadmap clearly and hold ourselves accountable to it IKEA has long been a global leader in home furnishing. We are proud of our vision to improve the everyday life of the many people. But our industry is quickly changing, and we need to adapt to stay competitive. We see so many opportunities for what we can accomplish and have the ambition to be a world-class team. At the same time, we believe that our work is not just about building models, but also about learning and having fun together
